about: Multi-cell root test/ files left in test/ as journeys, each with why it cannot live in one cell yet: it runs the CLI, spawns a non-git child, installs hooks, drives a browser, or imports past a cell front door. Components (front doors only, no CLI or hooks) move beside their lowest-order cell. Regenerated by the cells test moves; read by the test conformance scanner [C7].
